Name: MineExtensions
Author: NotAGardener
Description:
[center] ﻿﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/IlARo7u.png[/img][/center][center]
[size=4]Removes the fake mineshafts from the mine walls and expands the mine floors to add more area.

[/size]I mean... there isn't alot to say about this mod... it just removes the fake walls and expands the mine floors...﻿

[size=4]Installing:
Make sure you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] installed,﻿﻿
Unzip the file into:[code]﻿C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods
[/code]Run Stardew Valley[/size]
[/center]
